api_keys.empty_description: Create an API key to integrate Sink with your own tools and apps.

form.name: Name
form.scopes_description: Read allows querying and listing links. Write also allows creating, editing, and deleting links.
form.expiration_description: The key stops working after it expires. Leave empty for no expiration.

token.title: API key created
token.description: Copy your API key now and store it somewhere safe.
token.warning: For security reasons, the full key is shown only once and cannot be recovered.

revoke.title: Revoke {name}?
revoke.description: Requests made with this key will immediately stop working.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This permanently deletes the key record and cannot be undone.
